h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jabalpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jabalpur

items.pText: Jabalpur stands on the Narmada, with the marble rocks of Bhedaghat close by, and it has long been a cantonment city with defence establishments and their housing estates. Many of our enquiries here come from estate offices, schools and colonies that employ their own maintenance staff. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these buyers at our factory in Vasai, about 840 km away, and delivers it by road.

Where a site has a permanent maintenance team, the handover matters as much as the installation. Those staff will look after the equipment for years after our crew has left. So at handover we take them through the maintenance steps, show which parts to check and explain what the warranty expects of them. Jabalpur's hot summers and strong monsoon make that routine a big part of how long the equipment lasts.

richText.heading: What your maintenance staff should know

c: Bolts and fixings on every piece should be checked and tightened on a fixed schedule. Springs, swing hangers and bearings carry a 1-year warranty and wear fastest, so they need the closest watch. Plastic parts and slides only need washing with water and a soft cloth, never harsh scrubbing pads or solvents. Keep a simple register of each check and every part replaced. Before and after the monsoon, inspect the foundations for any loosening.

items.q: What maintenance does playground equipment need?
items.a: Regular checks of bolts and moving parts, washing of plastic parts with water and a soft cloth, and an inspection of foundations around the monsoon. We explain these steps to your staff at handover.

items.q: Can cantonment and defence estates order from you?
items.a: Yes. Estate offices, schools and colonies can order directly. We share a layout drawing and itemised quote for approval, then manufacture at Vasai, deliver by road and install.

It shows when each part was checked or replaced, which helps your staff plan the next round. It is also useful when you contact our after-sales team about a warranty claim. A copy of the register also helps a new caretaker pick up the routine.
